We can all agree that there’s content somewhere that we don’t want to see. The simple answer till now has been to either not subscribe or block their verses. That’s not an option for me and what seems to be the vast majority of the users here.

So here’s my idea: Voat could devise a ‘Redactor’ tool. The tool would be designed to look for user selectable keywords on a voat page, specifically in the comments section. If a keyword is found, the tool blacks out the entire comment’s text (only that comment) so it can’t be seen. Or, maybe it changes the color of the text so that it’s white and would require the user to highlight the section if they wanted to actually read it. Think about it like a classified document that has been released with bits cut out.

This option doesn’t limit anyone’s free expression but it resolves an individual user’s problem with seeing content they don’t want to see. It will provide a valid solution to stop the SJW’s from having legitimate gripes, as well as doesn’t limit anyone else’s ability to see something.

German WWI Propaganda Map - 'What would remain of the Entente, if they were sincere about the right of their nations to self-determination and would let go of the reins!'

Was von der Entente übrig bliebe, wenn sie Ernst machte mit dem „Selbstbestimmungsrecht“ ihrer eigenen Völker und die Zügel losliesse!

What would remain of the Entente, if they were sincere about the right of their nations to self-determination and would let go of the reins!

Not the snappiest of slogans, but in my humble opinion nonetheless an effective piece of PR.

It was intended to expose the hypocrisy of the claim of the Entente (UK, France, Russia and later US) that they were fighting for the right to self-determination of the nations of Europe, while at the same time subjugating huge populations of peoples themselves.

Fremdvölker in the box at the bottom means foreign peoples. If there are more translation questions, I would be happy to help.
